description:
Flying out to the outer planets, the HUD speed readout just says 'NaN km/s' the whole way. Looks completely broken.

## Reporter answers (follow-up)

Q: The fix modified src/lib/orbital/fly-physics.ts (the advisor-confirmed owner) and the hidden acceptance still fails (FAIL (ftp_still_failing=2, regressions=0)). Localization is settled — what is the exact expected behavior at that location: formulas, units, reference values, and edge-case handling?
A: The bug is in the spacecraft speed readout on the /fly HUD (shown as "NN km/s"). The readout is computed from the vis-viva relation using the spacecraft's current radius and the transfer orbit's semi-major axis. Expected behavior: (1) when the spacecraft's radius is beyond the transfer orbit's apohelion (aphelion) — i.e. the vis-viva radicand goes negative — the readout should fall back to the local circular orbital speed at that radius: sqrt(mu / r), not extrapolate, not clamp to the apohelion speed, and not hide the readout. (2) at radius = 0 it should return 0, not NaN. Units are km/s. I don't know specific reference numerical values for mu or expected speeds at given radii — only the formulas and the two edge cases (beyond apohelion → sqrt(mu/r), radius = 0 → 0).
